### run to setup 
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
### package loading
library(here)
library(car)
library(lattice)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lsmeans)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
library(forcats)
library(PNWColors)
library(stargazer)
library(agricolae)
library(rstatix)
library(plotrix)
library(vegan)
library(multcompView)
library(multcomp)
library(cluster)
library(ggrepel)
library(writexl)
library(anytime)

### data reading
here::i_am("carbon_sequestration_2023.2024.Rmd")
combine <- read.csv(here("carboncombined.csv"))
combine$UNIX <- as.POSIXct(combine$UNIX, origin="1970-01-01")

wunderdata <- read.csv(here("wunderdata.csv"))
wunderdata$Date <- as.POSIXct(wunderdata$UNIX, origin="1970-01-01")

tidedata <- read.csv(here("tidedata.csv"))
tidedata$Date <- as.POSIXct(tidedata$UNIX, origin="1970-01-01")

eelgrass_density_raw <- read.csv(here("CS_eelgrassdensity.csv"))
eelgrass_measures_raw <- read.csv(here("CS_eelgrassmeasures.csv"))
densitydiff <- read.csv("densitydiff.csv")
measdiff <- read.csv("measdiff.csv")

### ggplot themes and palettes
aes <- theme_set(  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position='none',
        axis.title.x=element_text(vjust=-1,
                                  size=12),
        axis.title.y=element_text(vjust=3,
                                  size=12)))

aes2 <- theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        margin(b = 10),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(
          colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
        axis.title.x=element_text(vjust=-1,
                                  size=14),
        axis.title.y=element_text(vjust=3,
                                  size=14),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5), "cm")))

regionpal <- c("North Bay" = "#625a94", 
               "North Central" = "#f9ad2a",
               "South Central" = "#f57946", 
               "South Bay" = "#cc5c76")
sitepal <- c("NB-1" = "#FF3300", "NB-2" = "#FF6600", "NB-3" = "#660000", "NC-1" = "#99FF66", "NC-2" = "#339900", "NC-3" = "#336600", "SC-1"= "#66CCFF", "SC-2" = "#3399FF", "SC-3" = "#003366", "SB-1" = "#FF33FF", "SB-2" = "#9900CC", "SB-3" = "#330066")
trtpal <- pnw_palette(
  name="Bay",n=3,type='discrete')
monthpal <- pnw_palette("Bay",8,type="continuous")

# scale limits
lims <- as.POSIXct(strptime(c("2023-11-01 00:00","2024-12-01 00:00"), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))

pHlims <- as.POSIXct(strptime(c("2024-07-01 00:00","2024-08-01 00:00"), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))

### YSI data wrangling
dataonly <- combine %>% 
  filter(Data.Type_depth == "Data" | Data.Type_depth == "Blank") %>% 
  filter(Data.Type.sal != "Error") %>% 
  # filter out errors and calibration events
  mutate(month = case_when(
    Month.Year == 112023 ~ "Nov '23",
    Month.Year == 122023 ~ "Dec '23",
    Month.Year == 12024 ~ "Jan '24",
    Month.Year == 22024 ~ "Feb '24",
    Month.Year == 32024 ~ "Mar '24",
    Month.Year == 42024 ~ "Apr '24",
    Month.Year == 52024 ~ "May '24",
    Month.Year == 62024 ~ "Jun '24",
    Month.Year == 72024 ~ "Jul '24",
    Month.Year == 82024 ~ "Aug '24",
    Month.Year == 92024 ~ "Sep '24",
    Month.Year == 102024 ~ "Oct '24",
    Month.Year == 112024 ~ "Nov '24",
    TRUE ~ "other")) %>%
  # standardize months
  mutate(Turbidity.errors = ifelse(
    Turbidity.FNU < 0 | Turbidity.FNU > 25, NA, Turbidity.FNU)) %>%
  mutate(errordata = case_when(
    month == "Mar '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & ODO...sat < 85 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Mar '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & ODO.mg.L.adjusted < 6.5 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Apr '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45385.50 & pH.adjusted < 8 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Apr '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45385.50 & ODO...sat < 75 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Apr '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45385.50 & ODO.mg.L.adjusted < 6 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Apr '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45385.50 & Sal.adjusted < 31.7 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Apr '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45385.50 & Turbidity.FNU > 1000 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Apr '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45407.00 & Sal.adjusted < 32.2 ~ "Yes",
    month == "May '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45441.00 & pH.adjusted < 8 ~ "Yes",
    month == "May '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45441.00 & ODO...sat < 65 ~ "Yes",
    month == "May '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45441.00 & ODO.mg.L.adjusted < 5 ~ "Yes",
    month == "May '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45441.00 & Sal.adjusted < 34 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Jun '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 34.24 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Jun '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & pH.adjusted < 8 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Jun '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & ODO...sat < 75 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Jun '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & ODO.mg.L.adjusted < 5 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Jul '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 33.5 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Jul '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 3 North-Central SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 33 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Jul '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & pH.adjusted < 8 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Jul '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & ODO...sat < 50 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Aug '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 33.5 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Aug '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & pH.adjusted < 8.1 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Aug '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45534.00 & pH.adjusted < 8.15 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Aug '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & ODO...sat < 75 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Aug '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & ODO.mg.L.adjusted < 5 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Sep '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 34.75 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Sep '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 33.7 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Sep '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 3 North-Central SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 33.2 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Sep '24" & pH.adjusted < 8.11 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Sep '24" & UNIX..unconverted. > 45550.05 & pH.adjusted < 8.16 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Sep '24" & ODO...sat < 70 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Oct '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 34.7 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Oct '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 33.5 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Oct '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & pH.adjusted < 8.15 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Oct '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & ODO...sat < 75 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Oct '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & ODO...sat < 75 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Oct '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 34.5 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Nov '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 34.5 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Nov '24" & Site.Name == "Site # 4 North SD Bay" & Sal.adjusted < 32.3 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Nov '24" & pH.adjusted < 8.17 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Nov '24" & ODO...sat < 60 ~ "Yes",
    month == "Nov '24" & ODO.mg.L.adjusted < 2.75 ~ "Yes",
    TRUE ~ "No")) %>%
  # filter out spikes
  mutate(site = case_when(
    Site.Name == "Site # 1 South SD Bay"~ "South Bay",
    Site.Name == "Site # 2 South-Central SD Bay"~ "South Central",
    Site.Name == "Site # 3 North-Central SD Bay"~ "North Central",
    Site.Name == "Site # 4 North SD Bay"~ "North Bay",
    TRUE ~ ".")) %>% 
  filter(errordata == "No") 

dataonly$site <- factor(dataonly$site, levels = c("North Bay", "North Central", "South Central", "South Bay"))

dailymeans <- dataonly %>% 
  mutate(POSIXdate = as.POSIXct(Date..MM.DD.YYYY.,
                                     format = "%m/%d/%Y")) %>% 
  group_by(POSIXdate, site) %>% 
  summarise(meanTemp = mean(Temp..C),
            meanSal = mean(Sal.adjusted),
            meanpH = mean(pH.adjusted),
            meanDO = mean(ODO...sat),
            meanDOconc = mean(ODO.mg.L.adjusted),
            meanDepth = mean(Depth.adjusted),
            meanTurb = mean(Turbidity.errors))

# eelgrass density wrangling
eelgrass_density <- eelgrass_density_raw %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(scaledDensity = Density*16) %>% 
    group_by(Year, Month, Ecoregion, Treatment, Replicate) %>% 
  summarise(meanDensity = mean(scaledDensity)) %>% 
  mutate(sqrtDensity = sqrt(meanDensity)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(time = case_when(Month == "Mar" ~ "0",
                          Month == "Apr" ~ "31",
                          Month == "Jun" ~ "92",
                          Month == "Jul" ~ "122",
                          Month == "Aug" ~ "153",
                          Month == "Oct" ~ "214",
                          Month == "Nov" ~ "245",
                          TRUE ~ "other")) %>% 
  mutate(RegionTrt = case_when(
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "NB-Full",
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "NB-Half",
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "NB-Ref",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "NC-Full",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "NC-Half",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "NC-Ref",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "SC-Full",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "SC-Half",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "SC-Ref",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "SB-Full",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "SB-Half",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "SB-Ref",
    TRUE ~ "other")) %>% 
  mutate(RegionLetter = case_when(
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" ~ "A",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" ~ "B",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" ~ "B",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" ~ "C",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(TreatmentLetter = case_when(
    Treatment == "Reference" ~ "A",
    Treatment == "Half" ~ "A",
    Treatment == "Full" ~ "A",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(RegTrtLetter = case_when(
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "ABC",
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "AB",
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "AB",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "D",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "CD",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "CD",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "BCD",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "CD",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "CD",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "A",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "A",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "A",
    TRUE ~ "other"))

# density facet ordering
eelgrass_density$Ecoregion <- factor(
  eelgrass_density$Ecoregion, levels = c(
    'North Bay', 'North Central', 'South Central', 'South Bay'))
eelgrass_density$Treatment <- factor(
  eelgrass_density$Treatment, levels = c(
    'Full', 'Half', 'Reference'))
# setting time as a factor
eelgrass_density$time <- as.numeric(as.character(eelgrass_density$time))

# eelgrass measures wrangling
eelgrass_measures <- eelgrass_measures_raw %>% 
  mutate(across(c(
        Leaf.Length..cm., Leaf.Width..cm., Leaf.Width..mm., Leaf.Area..cm2.),
        ~na_if(.,0))) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  group_by(Year, Month, Ecoregion, Treatment, Replicate) %>% 
  summarise(meanLeafArea = mean(Leaf.Area..cm2.)) %>% 
  mutate(sqrtLeafArea = sqrt(meanLeafArea)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(time = case_when(Month == "Mar" ~ "0",
                          Month == "Apr" ~ "31",
                          Month == "Jun" ~ "92",
                          Month == "Jul" ~ "122",
                          Month == "Aug" ~ "153",
                          Month == "Oct" ~ "214",
                          Month == "Nov" ~ "245",
                          TRUE ~ "other")) %>% 
  mutate(RegionLetter = case_when(
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" ~ "A",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" ~ "B",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" ~ "C",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" ~ "BC",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(TreatmentLetter = case_when(
    Treatment == "Reference" ~ "B",
    Treatment == "Half" ~ "A",
    Treatment == "Full" ~ "A",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(RegTrtLetter = case_when(
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "AF",
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "A",
    Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "A",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "E",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "CDE",
    Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "BCDE",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "BCDE",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "ABCF",
    Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "ABF",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "DE",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "BCDE",
    Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "BCDF",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  ))
# measures facet ordering
eelgrass_measures$Ecoregion <- factor(
  eelgrass_measures$Ecoregion, levels = c(
    'North Bay', 'North Central', 'South Central', 'South Bay'))
eelgrass_measures$Treatment <- factor(
  eelgrass_measures$Treatment, levels = c(
    'Full', 'Half', 'Reference'))

# setting time as a factor
eelgrass_measures$time <- as.numeric(as.character(eelgrass_measures$time))

# eelgrass density change over time
density_monthly_diff <- densitydiff %>% 
  filter(Season != "Test") %>% 
  group_by(Month, Treatment) %>% #Ecoregion
  summarise(meanDensityDiff = mean(DensityDiff),
            sdDensityDiff = sd(DensityDiff))
density_monthly_diff$Month <- factor(
  density_monthly_diff$Month, levels = c(
    'Mar-Apr', 'Apr-Jun', 'Jun-Jul', 'Jul-Aug', 'Aug-Oct', 'Oct-Nov'))
density_monthly_diff$Treatment <- factor(
  density_monthly_diff$Treatment, levels = c(
    'Reference', 'Half', 'Full'))

# eelgrass leaf area change over time
measdiff$Month <- factor(
  measdiff$Month, levels = c(
    'Mar-Apr', 'Apr-Jun', 'Jun-Jul', 'Jul-Aug',
    'Aug-Oct', 'Oct-Nov'))
measdiff$Season <- factor(
  measdiff$Season, levels = c(
    'Early Summer', 'Late Summer', 'Fall'))

measdiff_summary <- measdiff %>% 
  group_by(Month, Treatment) %>% 
  summarise(meanLADiff = mean(LeafAreaDiff),
            sdLADiff = sd(LeafAreaDiff))
```

### water quality data summary
```{r}
wq_summary <- dataonly %>% 
  dplyr::select(Temp..C, 
                pH.adjusted, 
                Sal.adjusted, 
                ODO...sat, 
                ODO.mg.L.adjusted,
                Turbidity.errors,
                Depth.adjusted,
                month,
                site) %>%
  na.omit(T) %>% 
  group_by(month,
           site) %>% 
  summarise_all(list(mean = mean,
                     median = median,
                     sd = sd,
                     max = max,
                     min = min))

# factor releveling
wq_summary$site <- factor(
  wq_summary$site, 
  levels = c("North Bay", "North Central", "South Central", "South Bay"))
wq_summary$month <- factor(
  wq_summary$month, 
  levels = c(
    "Nov '23", "Dec '23", "Jan '24", "Feb '24", "Mar '24", "Apr '24", "May '24", "Jun '24", "Jul '24", "Aug '24", "Sep '24", "Oct '24", "Nov '24"))
```

### [water quality graphs]
```{r}
# salinity
# plot for salinity at every timestamp
salinity <- ggplot(data=dataonly, aes(x=UNIX, y=Sal.adjusted, col=site)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab ("Sal. (PSU)") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 month",
                   date_labels = "%b %y",
                   limits = lims) +
  # facet_wrap(~site, ncol = 2) + 
  labs(fill="Ecoregion") +
  labs(color="Ecoregion") +
  scale_color_manual(values=regionpal) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=regionpal) +
  aes2 +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x=element_text(vjust=-1,
                                  size=12),
        axis.title.y=element_text(vjust=3,
                                  size=12)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes =
                               list(linewidth=3)))
  
salinity

  scale_fill_manual(values=regionpal) +
```

### [biotic data, eelgrass comparisons]
# means and SE
```{r}
# means and SE for density
densitysum_region <- eelgrass_density %>% # by ecoregion
  dplyr::select(Ecoregion, meanDensity) %>% 
  group_by(Ecoregion) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  summarise_all(list(mean = ~mean(.), sd = ~sd(.), se = ~std.error(.)))

densitysum_treatment <- eelgrass_density %>% # by treatment
  dplyr::select(Treatment, meanDensity) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  summarise_all(list(mean = ~mean(.), sd = ~sd(.), se = ~std.error(.)))

densitysum_regiontreatment <- eelgrass_density %>% # by ecoregion + treatment
  dplyr::select(Ecoregion, Treatment, meanDensity) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment, Ecoregion) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  summarise_all(list(mean = ~mean(.), sd = ~sd(.), se = ~std.error(.)))

# means and SE for Leaf Area
areasum_region <- eelgrass_measures %>% # by ecoregion
  dplyr::select(Ecoregion, meanLeafArea) %>% 
  group_by(Ecoregion) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  summarise_all(list(mean = ~mean(.), sd = ~sd(.), se = ~std.error(.)))

areasum_treatment <- eelgrass_measures %>% # by treatment
  dplyr::select(Treatment, meanLeafArea) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  summarise_all(list(mean = ~mean(.), sd = ~sd(.), se = ~std.error(.)))

areasum_regiontreatment <- eelgrass_measures %>% # by ecoregion + treatment
  dplyr::select(Ecoregion, Treatment, meanLeafArea) %>% 
  group_by(Ecoregion, Treatment) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  summarise_all(list(mean = ~mean(.), sd = ~sd(.), se = ~sd(./sqrt(.))))
```

# cluster analysis
```{r}
# determine whether sites within each ecoregion cluster together
cluster_density <- eelgrass_density_raw %>% 
  na.omit %>% 
  group_by(Month, Site, Ecoregion) %>% 
  summarise(meanDensity = mean(Density)) %>%
  ungroup() 

cluster_leafarea <- eelgrass_measures_raw %>% 
  na.omit %>% 
  group_by(Month, Site, Ecoregion) %>% 
  summarise(meanLeafArea = mean(Leaf.Area..cm2.)) %>%
  ungroup() 

cluster_metrics <- cluster_density %>% 
  left_join(cluster_leafarea) %>% 
  dplyr::select(2:5)

# includes both variables
mds_site <- cmdscale(dist(cluster_metrics[, 1:4]))
kmeans_clusters <- kmeans(mds_site, centers = 4)$cluster

# density
mds_site_density <- cmdscale(dist(cluster_density[, 2:4]))
kmeans_clusters_density <- kmeans(mds_site_density, centers = 4)$cluster

# leaf area
mds_site_leafarea <- cmdscale(dist(cluster_leafarea[, 2:4]))
kmeans_clusters_leafarea <- kmeans(mds_site_leafarea, centers = 12)$cluster

# Add cluster information to the MDS results
mds_df_density <- as.data.frame(mds_site_density)
mds_df_density$groups <- as.factor(kmeans_clusters_density)
mds_df_density$Site <- cluster_density$Site
mds_df_density$Ecoregion <- cluster_density$Ecoregion

mds_df_leafarea <- as.data.frame(mds_site_leafarea)
mds_df_leafarea$groups <- as.factor(kmeans_clusters_leafarea)
mds_df_leafarea$Site <- cluster_leafarea$Site
mds_df_leafarea$Ecoregion <- cluster_leafarea$Ecoregion

mds_df <- as.data.frame(mds_site)
mds_df$groups <- as.factor(kmeans_clusters)
mds_df$Site <- cluster_metrics$Site
mds_df$Ecoregion <- cluster_metrics$Ecoregion
mds_df$Site <- cluster_metrics$Site

# cluster plot for sites including both density and leaf area
density_mds <- ggscatter(mds_df_density, x = "V1", y = "V2",
          color = "Site",
          size = 3,
          ellipse = TRUE,
          ellipse.type = "convex",
          title = "K-means Clustering of Sites by Density",
          xlab = "MDS Dimension 1",
          ylab = "MDS Dimension 2") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Site), box.padding = 0.5,
                  max.overlaps = 10) 

density_mds

leafarea_mds <- ggscatter(mds_df_leafarea, x = "V1", y = "V2",
          color = "Site",
          size = 3,
          ellipse = TRUE,
          ellipse.type = "convex",
          title = "K-means Clustering of Sites by Leaf Area",
          xlab = "MDS Dimension 1",
          ylab = "MDS Dimension 2") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Site), box.padding = 0.5,
                  max.overlaps = 10) 

leafarea_mds

metrics_mds <- ggscatter(mds_df, x = "V1", y = "V2",
          color = "Site",
          size = 3,
          ellipse = TRUE,
          ellipse.type = "convex",
          title = "K-means Clustering of Sites by Eelgrass Metrics",
          xlab = "MDS Dimension 1",
          ylab = "MDS Dimension 2") +
```

```{r}
# density between ecoregion
dplyr::count(eelgrass_density, Ecoregion) # equal sample size but not really because averaging was not equal
hist(eelgrass_density$sqrtDensity)
leveneTest(sqrtDensity ~ Ecoregion, data = eelgrass_density) # unequal variance, need to use Welch's ANOVA + games-howell post hoc analysis

regaovsum <- as.data.frame(oneway.test(sqrtDensity ~ Ecoregion, data = eelgrass_density, var.equal = FALSE))
# significant differences detected between ecoregions
reg_gh <- games_howell_test(eelgrass_density, sqrtDensity~Ecoregion, conf.level = 0.90, detailed = FALSE) # post-hoc for Welch's ANOVA, North Central and South Central not significantly different, everything else is.
reg_gh
# densities by treatment
dplyr::count(eelgrass_density, Treatment)
leveneTest(sqrtDensity ~ Treatment, data = eelgrass_density) # same with ecoregion

trt_den_aov <- aov(sqrtDensity~Treatment, data = eelgrass_density)
summary(trt_den_aov)
trtden_tukey <- TukeyHSD(trt_den_aov)

# two-way ANOVA for ecoregion and treatment on density
type3 <- list(Ecoregion = contr.sum, Treatment = contr.sum) # setting contrasts

regiontrt_densitymodel <- lm(sqrtDensity ~ Ecoregion*Treatment, data = eelgrass_density, contrasts = type3) # linear model
regtrtden_aov <- Anova(regiontrt_densitymodel, type=3)
regtrtden_tukey <- TukeyHSD(aov(regiontrt_densitymodel), conf.level = 0.9, alpha = 0.1)
regtrt_den_cld <- regiontrt_densitymodel %>%
  emmeans(~ Ecoregion*Treatment) %>%
  cld(Letters = letters, adjust = "Tukey", sort = F, alpha = 0.1)
regtrt_den_cld
```

```{r}
eelgrass_density_time <- eelgrass_density %>% 
  group_by(time, Month, Treatment) %>% #Ecoregion
  summarise(meannDensity = mean(meanDensity),
            sdDensity = sd(meanDensity,na.rm=T)) %>% 
  mutate(Date = case_when(Month == "Mar" ~ "2024-03-11",
                   Month == "Apr" ~ "2024-04-29",
                   Month == "Jun" ~ "2024-06-04",
                   Month == "Jul" ~ "2024-07-11",
                   Month == "Aug" ~ "2024-08-29",
                   Month == "Oct" ~ "2024-10-07",
                   Month == "Nov" ~ "2024-11-04",
                   TRUE ~ "other")) %>%
  mutate(POSIXdate = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))

  eelgrass_density_time$Month, levels = c(
    'Mar', 'Apr', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Oct', 'Nov'))

month_den_plot <- ggplot(
```

### extra code
### total leaf area (not very clean)
```{r}
eelgrass_denarea_raw <- merge(
  eelgrass_density, eelgrass_measures, 
  by = c("Month", "Ecoregion", "Treatment", "Replicate"), 
  all = T) %>% 
  mutate(denarea = meanDensity*meanLeafArea)

eelgrass_denarea <- eelgrass_denarea_raw %>% 
  mutate(sqrtdenarea = sqrt(denarea)) %>% 
  mutate(Date = case_when(Month == "Mar" ~ "2024-03-11",
                   Month == "Apr" ~ "2024-04-29",
                   Month == "Jun" ~ "2024-06-04",
                   Month == "Jul" ~ "2024-07-11",
                   Month == "Aug" ~ "2024-08-29",
                   Month == "Oct" ~ "2024-10-07",
                   Month == "Nov" ~ "2024-11-04",
                   TRUE ~ "other")) %>% 
  mutate(denarealetters = 
           case_when(Ecoregion == "North Bay" ~ "A",
                     Ecoregion == "North Central" ~ "A",
                     Ecoregion == "South Central" ~ "A",
                     Ecoregion == "South Bay" ~ "B")) %>% 
  mutate(trtdenarealetters = 
           case_when(Treatment == "Full" ~ "A",
                     Treatment == "Half" ~ "A",
                     Treatment == "Reference" ~ "A")) %>% 
  mutate(regtrtdenarealetters = 
           case_when(Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "AB",
                     Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "AB",
                     Ecoregion == "North Bay" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "ABC",
                     Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "ABCD",
                     Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "ABCD",
                     Ecoregion == "North Central" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "ABC",
                     Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "ABCD",
                     Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "A",
                     Ecoregion == "South Central" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "A",
                     Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Reference" ~ "D",
                     Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Half" ~ "CD",
                     Ecoregion == "South Bay" & Treatment == "Full" ~ "BCD")) %>% 
  mutate(POSIXdate = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>% 
  group_by(POSIXdate, Treatment) %>% #Ecoregion
  summarise(meandenarea = mean(denarea),
            sddenarea = sd(denarea,na.rm=T))

hist(eelgrass_denarea$sqrtdenarea)
shapiro.test(eelgrass_denarea$sqrtdenarea)
leveneTest(sqrtdenarea~Treatment*Ecoregion, data=eelgrass_denarea)

summary(denarea_trtaov)
TukeyHSD(denarea_trtaov)

regtrt_denarea_cld <- denarea_trtaov %>%
  emmeans(~Ecoregion*Treatment) %>%
  cld(Letters = letters, adjust = "Tukey", sort = F, alpha = 0.1)
regtrt_denarea_cld

                width=10,

  theme(legend.position = "right",

  #facet_wrap(~Ecoregion, ncol = 2)

denarea_diff_plot

# North Bay
NBdenarea <- denareadiff %>% 
  filter(Ecoregion == "North Bay") %>% 
  na.omit(T)

hist(NBdenarea$DenAreaDiff)
shapiro.test(NBdenarea$DenAreaDiff)
leveneTest(DenAreaDiff~Treatment*Month, data = NBdenarea)

NBdenarea_anova <- aov(DenAreaDiff~Treatment*Month, data = NBdenarea)
summary(NBdenarea_anova)
options(max.print=2000)
TukeyHSD(NBdenarea_anova)

NBdenarea_plot <- ggplot(
  data=NBdenarea,
  aes(x=Treatment,
      y=DenAreaDiff,
      group=Treatment)) +
  ylab(expression(paste("Change in Total Leaf Area (cm"^"2",")"))) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Treatment)) +
  theme(legend.position='right') +
  scale_fill_manual(values=trtpal) +
  facet_wrap(~Month, nrow=1) +
  aes2 +
  labs(title="North Bay") +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_blank()) +
  theme(strip.background =element_rect(fill="grey97"))
```

```{r}
mar2024sal <- ggplot(data=mar2024, aes(x=UNIX, y=Sal.adjusted, col=site)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab ("Salinity (psu)") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 day",
                   date_labels = "%d %b",
                   limits = c(
      as.POSIXct("2024-03-01"),
      as.POSIXct("2024-03-31"))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.5),
                               title="Ecoregion"))
```

### water quality bar plot by month and by ecoregion
```{r}
# temperature
tempbars <- ggplot(data = wq_summary, 
                   aes(x = month,
                       y = Temp..C_mean,
                       group = site,
                       color = site)) +
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab(expression("Temperature " (degree*C))) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(13.5,26)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Temp..C_mean-Temp..C_sd, 
                    ymax=Temp..C_mean+Temp..C_sd), 
                    width=.5,
                    linewidth=0.7,
                    position=position_dodge(0)) + 
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank()) +
  labs(color="Ecoregion") +
  scale_color_manual(values=regionpal)

tempbars

# pH
pHbars <- ggplot(data = wq_summary, 
                   aes(x = month,
                       y = pH.adjusted_mean,
                       group = site,
                       color = site)) +
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab(expression("pH")) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(7.9,8.55)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pH.adjusted_mean-pH.adjusted_sd, 
                    ymax=pH.adjusted_mean+pH.adjusted_sd), 
                    width=.5,
                    linewidth=0.7,
                    position=position_dodge(0)) +

        axis.ticks.x=element_blank()) +
  labs(color="Ecoregion") +
```

```{r}
monthlevel_order <- c("Nov '23", "Dec '23", "Jan '24", "Feb '24", "Mar '24", "Apr '24", "May '24", "Jun '24", "Jul '24", "Aug '24", "Sep '24", "Oct '24", "Nov '24") 

# salinity
salinity <- dataonly %>% 
  group_by(month, site) %>% 
  summarize(mean_salinity = mean(Sal.adjusted, na.rm=T),
            sd_salinity = sd(Sal.adjusted, na.rm=T))

salinity_monthlyaverage <- ggplot(
  data=salinity, aes(
    x=month,
    y=mean_salinity,
    fill=site)) +
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab("Salinity (psu)") +
  geom_bar(
    position="dodge", stat="identity") +
  geom_errorbar(
    data=salinity, aes(
      x=month,
      ymin = mean_salinity-sd_salinity,
      ymax = mean_salinity+sd_salinity),
    position="dodge", stat="identity") +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = monthlevel_order) +
  guides(
    fill=guide_legend(title="Ecoregion")) +
  theme_bw()
```
